title: ACT ON THE TRANSFER OF INHERITED PROPERTIES ATTRIBUTABLE TO THE STATE
title_original: 국가에 귀속하는 상속재산 이전에 관한 법률
full_text:
Article 1 (Transfer of Property in the Republic of Korea)
A steward of inherited property which escheats to the State pursuant to Article 1058 (1) of the Civil Act shall transfer without delay the stewardship of the inherited property to the head of the tax office having jurisdiction over the place of domicile of the ancestor.
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 9806, Oct. 21, 2009]

Article 2 (Transfer of Property outside the Republic of Korea)
If the ancestor's domicile is in the outside of the Republic of Korea in cases under Article 1, the stewardship of the inherited property shall be transferred without delay to a consul, or a person who performs consul's duties on his/her behalf.
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 9806, Oct. 21, 2009]

ADDENDUM<Act No. 9806, Oct. 21, 2009>
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
